short: Expand the kernel into orbital terms

lean.name: Formalism.L2.SG.TermOp.KExpansion
lean.plain: Expand the kernel into orbital terms
lean.note: The two Poincaré series are paired by summing operators indexed by integral double cosets. The sum gives a single operator on the spaces of coefficient vectors, so each contribution to the Gram bounds can be estimated before reassembling the pairing.
